# LumenLab

> Free curated resources for open science, education, creative tools, and the best free AI platforms.
> Designed to be useful for both humans and AI agents.
> Currently ad-free and tracking-free.

## Purpose
LumenLab collects high-quality free resources in four categories:
1. Open Science (preprints, open data, open access)
2. Education (courses, textbooks, simulations)
3. Creative Tools (design, coding, making)
4. Free AI Platforms (chat, research, image, coding)

## Key resources
- arXiv – https://arxiv.org
- MIT OpenCourseWare – https://ocw.mit.edu
- Photopea – https://www.photopea.com
- ChatGPT – https://chatgpt.com
- Google Gemini – https://gemini.google.com
- Claude – https://claude.ai
- Perplexity – https://www.perplexity.ai
- NotebookLM – https://notebooklm.google.com
- Internet Archive – https://archive.org

## Machine-readable data
- JSON feed of all resources: /data.json
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- This file: /llms.txt
